cover_letter:
Dear Base360 Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Growth Marketer role at Base360. Your mission to build the operating system for B2C brands, powered by AI, immediately captured my attention. I am deeply aligned with your emphasis on hands-on growth, experimentation, and leveraging modern tools, particularly AI, to achieve measurable results.

My background as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto has provided me with practical experience in owning crucial aspects of organic growth, from conducting thorough keyword research and implementing on-page SEO to crafting keyword-targeted content and managing full-cycle WordPress site builds. I am adept at tracking performance using tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics, consistently guiding my decisions with data to improve organic visibility and search rankings for clients.

What truly excites me about this opportunity is the chance to apply my AI-savvy approach and self-directed nature to a role where I can build and iterate rapidly. My personal project, mirook.com, exemplifies this drive. Through it, I independently designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented advanced structured data, entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to enhance visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO). This project involved iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, leading to measurable improvements in the site's search health score — a direct parallel to the experimental, data-obsessed mentality Base360 seeks.

I thrive in environments where I can learn fast, experiment, and build something significant from scratch. The opportunity to own a growth channel, generate leads, and obsess over conversion funnels for a fast-growing company like Base360 is precisely the challenge I am looking for. I am confident that my blend of technical marketing skills, analytical mindset, and entrepreneurial spirit makes me a strong candidate to help Base360 reach its ambitious goals.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I am eager to learn more about this role and discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
